name: Peas
tip: Sow 2.5 cm deep, give them a trellis. They love cold soil.

name: Spinach
tip: Bolts in heat, so sow early or in autumn.

name: Radish
tip: Fastest win: ready in about 4 weeks.

name: Lettuce
tip: Sow a short row every 2 weeks for a steady supply.

name: Carrots
tip: Keep the seedbed damp until they sprout.

name: Beets
tip: Soak seeds overnight to speed germination.

name: Onions (sets)
tip: Push sets in so the tip just shows.

name: Broccoli
tip: Harden seedlings off for a week before planting out.

name: Potatoes
tip: Plant seed potatoes 10 cm deep; earth up as they grow.

name: Beans (bush)
tip: Soil should be 16C+; they rot in cold wet ground.

name: Sweetcorn
tip: Plant in a block, not a row, for pollination.

name: Cucumber
tip: Needs warm soil and a sunny spot.

name: Squash / Zucchini
tip: Give each plant about a metre of room.

name: Tomatoes
tip: Bury the stem deep when transplanting; it roots along the stem.

name: Peppers
tip: Wait for warm nights before they go out.

name: Basil
tip: Any night under 10C and it sulks.

name: Garlic (autumn planting)
tip: Plant cloves pointy end up, 5 cm deep, before the ground freezes.
